verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Codegen as a hosted service that runs agents in its own isolated sandboxes and is reached through a GitHub App, API, SDK and CLI. Nothing documents deploying Codegen's agent infrastructure locally, in containers, or on customer VMs. The CLI wraps a user's local Claude Code and sends telemetry to the cloud, which is an adjacent feature and not self-hosting of Codegen itself.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can self-host agent infrastructure locally, in containers, or on my own VMs
